name: libc
about: C's own library, which every system has: memory, text, bytes, files, sorting
license: the system's own library; these declarations are PHI's

notes: The part of C's library that Windows (msvcrt.dll), macOS and Linux all have under the same names.
C's long is lng here, its size_t usz, and a FILE is held by its address.
PHI has its own text, files and memory: this is for code written against C's, and for what
another C library expects to be given (memory from malloc, a FILE).
C's maths (math.h): use vendor.libc.math; and CMath.sin, CMath.pow. On f64s.
